meta.prompt: Draft an email to my landlord about the broken heating and show it as an inline card I can edit before it goes: to, subject and body fields filled in, a tone switch between polite and firm that rewrites the body, and send and discard buttons. Sending needs a recipient and a subject, and afterwards the card shows it as sent.
meta.text:
Card w:390 gap:12 pad:16
  Text.heading "Draft to landlord"
  state to="landlord@example.com"
  state subject="Heating not working"
  state body=""
  state tone="polite"
  state sent=false
  if sent==false
    InputField "To" "landlord@example.com" =to
    InputField "Subject" "Subject" =subject
    Segments =tone options:["polite","firm"] -> body=tone=="firm"?"The heating in my flat has not worked for over a week, and I have reported it twice already. Please arrange a repair within 48 hours.":"Hi, I'm sorry to bother you, but the heating in my flat has stopped working. Could you arrange a repair when you have a chance? Thank you."
    InputField "Message" "Write your message" =body lines:6
    Row gap:10
      ActionButton "Discard" tone:quiet icon:"delete_outline" enabled:=true -> to="landlord@example.com"; subject="Heating not working"; body=""; tone="polite"
      ActionButton "Send" tone:primary icon:"send" enabled:=length(to)>0 && length(subject)>0 -> sent=true; emit send_email
  if sent
    Receipt "Email sent" "Sent to {to}" tone:good icon:"check_circle"
